responsibility: Declares the public target helper interfaces implemented by the C-SKY backend and referenced from machine descriptions, headers, and target hooks. The prototypes cover operand/address validation, PIC and TLS address legalization, move and call assembly output helpers, compare expansion, prologue/epilogue generation, argument passing state, branch-cost logic, constant-pool and push/pop length helpers, and FPUv3-specific move and immediate handling, making this the central declaration point for csky.cc and the .md files’ C helpers.
